silicon_melting_2_subtask_structure_retr.name: Silicon Structure Retrieval for Melting - Level 2
silicon_melting_2_subtask_structure_retr.description: Retrieve structure of Silicon and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

silicon_melting_2_subtask_potential_file.name: Silicon Potential File for Melting - Level 2
silicon_melting_2_subtask_potential_file.description: Procure the appropriate Stillinger–Weber (SW) potential file for Silicon for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

silicon_melting_2_subtask_melting.name: Silicon NPT Melting - Level 2
silicon_melting_2_subtask_melting.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Silicon structure file and Stillinger–Weber potential file appropriate for MD simulations, simulate the melting of the system by heating it under NPT. Use the partial radial distribution function (RDF) to determine the Si–Si bond length after melting. Report the bond length corresponding to the first RDF peak in Å.
